description.narrative: In March 2014, the Director-General met with the Ghanaian high level authorities during his mission in Accra, including the Head of State, and the Minister of Trade and Industry (MoTI). The DG also met with the UNCT, the donor community and other strategic partners. The overall discussions focused on the relevance of UNIDO for Ghana, and how to better fast track the economic transformation of the country through the Inclusive and Sustainable Industrial Development (ISID) initiative. Indeed UNIDO#s new ISID mandate provides an opportune time to re-position and strengthen cooperation with the country. Beside this important visit of DG, the Government has also expressed its interest in technical assistance from UNIDO on other occasions - requests for technical assistance in industrial statistics and industrial policy development have been made at the General Conference in Lima in December 2013, and again reaffirmed at a meeting with the Minister of Trade and Industry during the first ISID forum in June 2014. The authorities reiterated the request for UNIDO#s technical assistance and it was agreed to develop a Country Programme formulation mission to Ghana in a timeframe to be mutually agreed.
